entities.name: HMSN/ACC
aliases: hereditary motor sensory neuropathy with agenesis of the corpus callosum

relationships.subject: KCC3
relationships.evidence_quote: HMSN/ACC occurs because of loss-of-function mutations in the potassium-chloride cotransporter 3 (KCC3)

relationships.subject: PV neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: the disease is caused by loss of KCC3 function in neurons and particularly parvalbumin (PV)-expressing neurons

key_findings: Disrupting or reintroducing KCC3 in PV neurons in adult mice does not affect locomotor behavior.
KCC3 expression is critical during embryonic/perinatal development; re-expression after onset does not reverse HMSN/ACC.
